title: Daily Signal Brief 005 — EU PTD T-6d fragments; Mobley 1.1B figure on record; Visier MCP missed
summary: EU Pay Transparency deadline 2026-06-07 still binds but applicability is now fragmented and rolling — Slovakia transposed first on 2026-04-15; Germany, France, Netherlands, Ireland, Spain, Denmark will all miss. Compass's posture statement should lead with 'ready in every member state from the moment its transposing law takes effect,' not 'ready for June 7.' Mobley v. Workday added a 2026-03-06 ruling rejecting Workday's ADEA-doesn't-cover-applicants dismissal and a 2026-03-30 amended complaint; Workday's own filing put 1.1 billion applications-rejected into the public record — Compass should weave the figure into the NYC-AEDT sales-enablement page this week. Calibration miss owned: Visier shipped its MCP server in November 2025 with 'governed people data into agentic workflows' framing — six months stale in our coverage; a Visier battlecard ships this week.
